text.p: Swedish car safety equipment maker Autoliv said on Tuesday it had set its next quarterly dividend at 11 cents a share to be paid on December 4.

Autoliv Inc , which merged with the ASP car safety unit division of U.S. Morton International on May 1 this year, said it planned to pay dividends four times a year on the first Thursday of every September, December, March and June.
Its last dividend, also of 11 cents a share, was announced on July 8 and will be paid on September 4.
Autoliv said its board had also assumed a so-called Shareholder Rights Plan that aims to make hostile takeovers more difficult.

"The plan is not a reaction to any hostile takeover bid and Autoliv does not know of any such attempt but the plan is being taken up in accordance with U.S. standards where Autoliv is registered," the company said in a statement.
